tea_waitress.text: Good afternoon. Do take a seat. The pot is silver and the pinkies are optional.
See the big mirror? Airmen based round Yorkshire in the war scratched their names on it with a diamond.

then.text: You've had your cream tea. Come back for another, and I'll pretend I never said it.

else.text: Here, a cream tea on the house. Scone first, jam, then cream. Yes, I know. Let's not start.

york_quizmaster.text: Welcome to the Bettys quiz, the only pub quiz where the tiebreaker is a Fat Rascal. Please, no hard feelings over the last scone.
Five questions. Phones away. And no, Dave, waving at the window does not count as phoning a friend.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Of course, dear. It's very civilised in here either way.

then.text: Ey up. The ovens are free, if you've got the makings.

else.text: Parkin, love. Oats, treacle, ginger, heather honey. Best a week old.
Nobody in Yorkshire has ever managed to leave one for a week. It's been tried. There were casualties.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. You can use my kitchen.
